name: Li Wei
source:
Protagonist of the main storyline.
Successor of the family treasure, the Licaijian sword.
He has lived an extremely sheltered life, not being able to set a foot outside of the family estate until his father's death.
He comes to Anluojie hoping to meet with his older sister Ming Ming, the clan's traitor.
